rules.activeApkCount: exactly one APK per registered package
rules.activeSidecars: one .apk.sha256 sidecar per active APK; no orphan sidecars
rules.historicalRetention: move superseded APKs and sidecars to _archived-apk-drops; never permanently delete as routine cleanup
rules.publicationOrder: upload or copy, verify metadata and downloaded SHA-256, then rename/archive and re-list
rules.driveInventory: the live Drive active folder must contain exactly the registered active APK names and no temporary or status-labeled APKs
